description:
Manage Focus ai with the following actions:

- **apply-ai-change**: Apply Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)
- **discard-ai-change**: Discard Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)
- **get-messages**: Get Messages Ai. (data: conversation_id*, limit)
- **run-ai-view**: Run Ai View Ai. (data: payload*{input*, tool*})
- **search**: Search Ai. (data: q*)
- **send-ai-message**: Send Ai Message Ai. (data: conversation_id*, payload*{text*, page_context})
- **undo-ai-change**: Undo Ai Change Ai. (data: conversation_id*, message_id*, view_id*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: apply-ai-change, discard-ai-change, get-messages, run-ai-view, search, send-ai-message, undo-ai-change

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
